rules: Observed Grid limits, cost status, land fit and queue counts come from the preview cores (gridrules.js, landcore.js, queuecore.js); observed price figures from prices.js analyzePrices on the settled 2025 RT basis. Finance and planning presets are explicitly illustrative assumptions.
basisNote: Every sample uses the settled 2025 RT basis at the option bus (one bus, one price). The Studio demo used case sp, horizon 2030, history 2025; the 2030 forecast figure is quoted beside it, never mixed in.

projects.name: Dummy — Cape Cod Solar (sample)
projects.narrative: A developer weighs a 100 MW solar project on Cape Cod, mirroring the Studio's Cape Cod Solar demo. Hatchville has its own price node and a clear-sky capture of $52.41/MWh (0.785 of its 2025 mean); QP624 OSP S1 borrows a neighbour's price and its upgrade cost is only a lower bound, so the choice turns on evidence quality as much as price.

options.label: Same-substation price
options.note: Studio demo option o1 (Cape Cod Solar). Priced at the price node at the same substation (LD.MASHPEE 23). Export limit 152.8 MW (Summer peak · export, fits); upgrade cost no upgrades indicated (Shoulder · export confirmed by the envelope only).

options.label: Own price node
options.note: Studio demo option o2. Priced at its own settlement node LD.HATCHVIL23. Export limit 197.8 MW (Summer peak · export, fits); upgrade cost no upgrades indicated (Shoulder · export confirmed by the envelope only).

options.label: Borrowed price
options.note: Nearest borrowed-price bus to Mashpee (10.7 mi) whose 100 MW solar upgrade cost is a Lower bound. Borrowed price: nearest node un.vnyrdwnd115 vinw is 1.0 km away. Export limit 55.7 MW (Shoulder · export, does not fit).

steps.what_to_look_at: By the Grid element-study rule, 1,462 of 2,678 buses fit 100 MW of solar export on every applicable case. Screen depth shows only these ISO-wide figures. Hatchville is one; its 2025 RT mean is $66.74.
Rank candidate buses under this project’s 100 MW export / 0 MW import request. Compare Mashpee with the pinned options; a score is a screen, not a permit or interconnection approval.
Sweep request size around 100 MW. Directional grid cases can change the ranking; use the same request on Grid before carrying a limit into Economics.
Compare ISO-NE regions at the selected technology and request size, then drill to Mashpee; an ISO-wide aggregate is not a site price.
9,592 clear acres in the 3-mile screen against 560 acres base footprint for 100 MW solar: fits on the habitat/protected screen only (Studio copy of the exclusions, older database).
Use the 100 MW technology footprint model and test clear-acreage sensitivity. The 60% site-control input is illustrative; parcel boundaries and title are not held.
The 1.2-mile route is an illustrative input. Move the route and crossing assumptions to see cost sensitivity; no surveyed corridor or right-of-way is represented.
Review permit sequence and site-control threshold for solar. Dates and statuses remain unverified until entered; a regional exclusion screen cannot establish a permit.
Mashpee: export limit 152.8 MW (Summer peak · export, fits). For pure solar only the export cases apply; the 99.2 MW shoulder-charge limit is irrelevant here.
Inspect limiting facilities and study vintage behind Mashpee’s export 152.8 MW (Summer peak · export, fits) and import not requested. A missing facility list remains unassessed.
QP624 OSP S1: Lower bound: at least $8.5M priced, and Shoulder · export binds with no facility costs held. A Lower bound is never shown as a total.
Compare smaller requests or import caps with Mashpee’s stored directional envelope. Alternative POIs and unstudied mitigation stay conditional.
No solved-case queue request lies within 10 mi of Hatchville; that does not mean the area is empty, only that the solved-case set holds none.

Use $15.0M = 100 MW × $0.15M/MW illustrative network-upgrade allowance; not a study estimate. The cash ladder is a what-if until Grid sends a priced allocation.
Inspect withdrawals, changed requests and study status near Mashpee. Nearby MW is context, not a one-for-one subtraction from grid headroom.

Hatchville: 2025 RT mean $66.74/MWh (P5 $22.18, P95 $183.56, 0.84% of hours negative) against the ISO-NE Internal Hub's $65.88. The 2030 forecast run averages $47.21 (quoted beside the basis, not mixed in).
